Groups Ops Add Users
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups/:id/users

Adds users to an existing group using the unique identifier ID of the group.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the group to which users will be added.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY ARRAYREQUIRED
Array [
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the referenced entity.

]
Responses
​
200
400
401

The request was successful, and users have been added to the group.
